dbToolScopingDenylist.customers: Synthetic contacts for the single shared demo shop; not workspace member identities. Access through ShopRepository.
dbToolScopingDenylist.products: Shared synthetic demo catalog, independent of workspace membership. Access through ShopRepository.
dbToolScopingDenylist.orders: Synthetic single-shop purchase snapshots shared by operators. Mutations use the transactional ShopRepository.
dbToolScopingDenylist.shipments: Synthetic single-shop delivery records. Writes serialize with the transactional ShopRepository.
dbToolScopingDenylist.requests: Synthetic support inbox for the single shared demo shop. Access through ShopRepository.
dbToolScopingDenylist.refunds: Synthetic single-shop refund history. Mutations use the transactional ShopRepository.
dbToolScopingDenylist.replies: Stored synthetic demo replies, not external mail or member-owned messages. Access through ShopRepository.
dbToolScopingDenylist.recipe_versions: Immutable recipes for the existing single shared synthetic demo shop; engine access through DrizzleRunRepository.
dbToolScopingDenylist.recipe_runs: Durable engine checkpoints for the single shared synthetic demo shop; access through recipe run actions and DrizzleRunRepository.
dbToolScopingDenylist.recipe_handoffs: Deduplicated escalation work for the single shared synthetic shop inbox; access through DrizzleAgentHandoff and recipe run actions.
dbToolScopingDenylist.recipes: Catalog metadata and active version pointers for the existing single shared synthetic shop; access through DrizzleRecipeCatalog.
dbToolScopingDenylist.recipe_skill_publications: Runtime skill publication receipts for the existing app-wide synthetic recipe catalog; accessed only through RecipeStudio and RecipeSkillRegistry, with no user credentials or customer data.
dbToolScopingDenylist.request_processing: Intake checkpoints for the existing single shared synthetic shop inbox; read through list-request-processing, writes through RequestIntake.
